definitions.gloss: huge success, great success, smashing success
definitions.explanation: An extremely successful outcome, much beyond ordinary success. Compound of {大|だい} (big, great) and {成功|せいこう} (success).

examples.japanese: ⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{大成功|だいせいこう}⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The event was a huge success.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新製品|しんせいひん}→新製品：18629_shinseihin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発売|はつばい}→発売：04315_hatsubai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{大成功|だいせいこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{終|お}わった→終わる：00567_owaru⟧。
examples.english: The launch of the new product ended in great success.

examples.japanese: {大成功|だいせいこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{収|おさ}めた→収める：02022_osameru⟧。
⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}けた→続ける：01231_tsuzukeru⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧、⟦{発表会|はっぴょうかい}→発表会：27716_happyoukai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{大成功|だいせいこう}⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: As a result of continued practice, the recital was a huge success.

examples.japanese: ⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦{進出|しんしゅつ}→進出：14387_shinshutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{大成功|だいせいこう}⟦し→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{後|ご}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{成長|せいちょう}→成長：03290_seichou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}けた→続ける：01231_tsuzukeru⟧。
examples.english: The first overseas expansion was a great success, and the company continued to grow after that.

notes:
{大成功|だいせいこう} emphasizes an outcome far beyond ordinary success. Used to describe events, projects, or ventures that achieved outstanding results.

ETYMOLOGY:
Compound of 大 (big, great) + ⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧ (success).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {大成功|だいせいこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{収|おさ}める→収める：02022_osameru⟧: achieve great success (formal)
- {大成功|だいせいこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{終|お}わる→終わる：00567_owaru⟧: end in great success
- {大成功|だいせいこう}⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧: was a huge success
- {大成功|だいせいこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be a huge success (verb usage)

SIMILAR 大 COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{大失敗|だいしっぱい}→大失敗：17916_daishippai⟧: huge failure (antonym)
- ⟦{大発見|だいはっけん}→大発見：28152_daihakken⟧: great discovery
- ⟦{大人気|だいにんき}→大人気：12205_daininki⟧: great popularity

USAGE:
Can function as a noun ({大成功|だいせいこう}⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧) or as a suru verb ({大成功|だいせいこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧). The suru verb form emphasizes the action of succeeding greatly.
